projects.title: University ERP System
projects.tagline: Comprehensive institutional management portal for academia, administration, and student records
projects.description: A full-featured web-based university management system designed to streamline and automate academic operations, student registries, faculty administration, attendance tracking, fees collection, and exam evaluations.
features: Admin dashboard with institutional overview metrics
Student management (enrollment, profiles, academic records)
Faculty management and department course allocation
Attendance tracking module with date & lecture filters
Course management and semester syllabus allocation
Fees and student payment transaction ledger
Examination marks entry and semester result publication
Comprehensive downloadable student & financial reports
Strict role-based access control (Admin, Faculty, Student)
projects.overview: Modern universities handle large amounts of administrative and academic data daily. This ERP system centralizes disparate departments into an integrated web portal, replacing scattered paperwork with structured relational database workflows.
projects.problem: Manual record keeping for course registrations, faculty schedules, and attendance creates administrative bottlenecks, high margin for data errors, and delays in releasing semester examination results.
projects.solution: Engineered a normalized MySQL database schema connected to PHP backend scripts with authenticated role sessions. Admins oversee university operations, faculty log daily attendance and test marks, while students inspect course materials and fee receipts.
developmentProcess: Requirement specification & relational entity-relationship (ER) modeling for university entities
Database schema normalization (3NF) to eliminate data redundancy and preserve referential integrity
Implementation of session-based authentication and granular role-based route middleware
Development of modular frontend views using reusable CSS and responsive data tables
Comprehensive testing of grading calculations, attendance percentages, and PDF report generation
challenges: Designing complex SQL relational queries with multiple JOIN operations across courses, semesters, and student marks without hurting query performance
Enforcing strict access boundaries so students cannot inspect unauthorized faculty evaluation rubrics
futureImprovements: Migrating frontend views to a modern React SPA for instantaneous client-side interactions
Integrating SMS/Email alert notifications for upcoming tuition dues and exam schedules
Adding automated barcode/biometric attendance device logging

projects.title: Clothing Shop Management System
projects.tagline: Point-of-sale inventory and transaction management engine tailored for apparel businesses
projects.description: A tailored inventory, billing, and order management system created for online and retail clothing/T-shirt brands, featuring automated stock counts, invoice printing, delivery tracking, and daily closing calculations.
features: Product catalog management with size, color, and SKU variations
Stock-in workflow and real-time inventory count tracking
Instant billing terminal with automated calculation
Printable clean customer invoices & receipts
Order status pipeline (Paid, Pending, Processing, Return)
Dynamic discount and promotional code logic
Configurable delivery charge computation based on region
End-of-day daily closing & cash reconciliation tally
Monthly revenue and inventory movement analytics
Secure administrative control panel
projects.overview: Managing an apparel and T-shirt enterprise requires tracking multi-variant stock (sizes S/M/L/XL, colors) and processing orders across physical counters and online delivery requests seamlessly.
projects.problem: Apparel merchants frequently suffer inventory mismatches when selling across online channels and in-person showrooms, losing track of pending customer couriers and returned packages.
projects.solution: Built a unified management engine with a fast React frontend connected to a PHP/MySQL API backend. When orders are drafted, stock automatically adjusts, printable invoices generate instantly, and courier statuses update with clear daily closing ledgers.
developmentProcess: Analyzed local retail workflows: inventory stocking, barcode/SKU labeling, billing, and returns
Designed dynamic variant schema supporting nested product attributes (size, color, batch)
Crafted an interactive cart and billing screen in React with instant calculation formulas
Built printable invoice templates with clean print CSS media queries
Implemented daily closing audit tools providing daily gross profit and pending courier summaries
challenges: Preventing double-allocation of limited inventory during high-volume sales rushes
Designing an ergonomic invoice print layout that prints crisply on thermal POS receipt and standard A4 printers
futureImprovements: Integration with courier API webhooks for automated live tracking updates
Adding low-stock SMS warnings when popular sizes fall below minimum threshold

projects.title: AI Perfume Recommendation System
projects.tagline: Intelligent fragrance profile analyzer offering personalized scent recommendations
projects.description: An AI-assisted web application that guides users through an intuitive sensory preference quiz and utilizes modern AI reasoning to recommend tailored perfume fragrance profiles, top/heart/base notes, and occasions.
features: Multi-step interactive olfactory preference questionnaire
Fragrance pyramid detection (Top, Heart, and Base notes)
AI-driven semantic scent profile matching and reasoning
Personalized recommendations based on weather, occasion, and mood
Ingredient notes breakdown (Citrus, Woody, Oriental, Gourmand, Floral)
Saved favorite fragrance profiles
projects.overview: Choosing fragrances online is notoriously challenging because buyers cannot physically smell perfumes before ordering. This system translates personal lifestyle, preferred weather, favorite scent memories, and budget into matched fragrance archetypes.
projects.problem: Most fragrance shopping platforms force users to browse hundreds of confusing perfume bottles with complex note descriptions that general consumers find intimidating.
projects.solution: Built a questionnaire capturing intuitive signals (favorite season, preferred daily vibes, occasion). An integrated AI model analyzes the user inputs and maps them into harmonious olfactory families, outputting personalized bottle and fragrance recommendations with clear explanations.
developmentProcess: Researched olfactory classifications: the Fragrance Wheel, scent longevity, and note transitions
Designed an accessible multi-step quiz UI with step-by-step state transitions in React
Engineered structured prompting pipelines returning validated JSON scent profiles
Crafted visual scent radar and note composition cards explaining why each perfume fits the user
challenges: Balancing creative fragrance descriptions with structured, predictable JSON response schemas
Making abstract sensory descriptions (e.g. 'fresh rain on warm cedar') accessible to beginner fragrance enthusiasts
futureImprovements: Direct integration with regional perfume retailers' inventory
Community rating system and sample vial ordering integration

projects.title: Sign Language Detection App
projects.tagline: Computer vision application translating hand signs and gestures into real-time readable text
projects.description: An assistive computer vision and machine learning project that detects human hand gestures via webcam input, maps skeletal landmark coordinates, and classifies signs into understandable textual output to bridge communication gaps.
features: Real-time webcam hand tracking and landmark keypoint detection
Gesture feature extraction and coordinate normalization
Multi-sign classification model recognizing alphabet and basic vocabulary
Visual feedback overlay showing hand skeletal joints
Instant textual transcription of recognized gestures
Responsive accessibility-first user interface
projects.overview: Sign language is the primary communication method for millions of deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals worldwide. This project investigates using affordable consumer webcams and computer vision to translate gestures into text in real time.
projects.problem: Communication barriers frequently isolate non-verbal individuals in educational, medical, and commercial environments where fluent sign language interpreters are unavailable.
projects.solution: Leveraged hand pose estimation algorithms to extract 21 3D hand landmarks per frame. Trained a lightweight classification pipeline that matches hand geometry against gesture datasets and prints the predicted letters and words with high confidence.
developmentProcess: Curated sign language gesture training samples under varying ambient lighting conditions
Implemented hand landmark extraction pipeline using vision models
Calculated angular and Euclidean coordinate vectors between fingertip joints
Developed an interactive dashboard rendering the camera feed alongside live classification scores
Fine-tuned confidence thresholds to reduce false positive gesture flickers
challenges: Handling variations in hand scale, rotation, and different camera lighting without dropping frame rates
Distinguishing signs with subtle finger curled differences (such as letters 'M', 'N', and 'S')
futureImprovements: Expanding vocabulary from static finger-spelling to dynamic continuous sentence gestures
Adding text-to-speech audio pronunciation for two-way conversation

projects.title: Nova AI Intelligence Platform
projects.tagline: Intelligent conversational assistant and multimodal reasoning engine powered by modern LLMs
projects.description: A next-generation AI assistant platform engineered with Gemini and modern Large Language Models (LLMs), featuring streaming responses, contextual multi-turn conversation memory, prompt engineering templates, and interactive data insights.
features: Real-time streaming AI chat responses with token-by-token rendering
Multi-turn conversation history and context-aware session management
Custom system prompts and specialized personas (Coding, Writing, Analysis)
Code snippet highlighting with 1-click copy and formatting
Dark mode cyberpunk UI with fluid animations and responsive layout
API rate-limiting protection and resilient server-side proxy integration
projects.overview: Nova AI brings cutting-edge artificial intelligence into an intuitive, ultra-responsive workspace. Built to explore practical LLM integration, it handles complex coding queries, research summarization, and interactive brainstorming sessions with minimal latency.
projects.problem: Off-the-shelf AI interfaces often lack customized developer tooling, lightweight responsive design, or safe proxy layers for deploying proprietary prompting workflows without exposing API credentials.
projects.solution: Constructed a full-stack architecture using React and Node.js. Server-side proxy endpoints safely handle API authorization with streaming response chunking, while the client delivers high-performance Markdown and syntax-highlighted code rendering.
developmentProcess: Designed futuristic cyberpunk UI with glowing indigo/cyan themes and fluid Motion animations
Integrated Gemini API using server-side secure endpoints for API key protection
Implemented Server-Sent Events (SSE) and stream readers for real-time text output
Built session caching to allow users to switch between multiple chat threads seamlessly
Optimized performance to ensure sub-100ms UI interaction latency
challenges: Managing smooth Markdown stream parsing as token chunks arrive asynchronously without layout shifts
Handling API token limits and gracefully managing network disconnection recovery
futureImprovements: Multimodal document & image analysis with OCR integration
Vector database embeddings for semantic search across user documents (RAG)

projects.title: Diagnostic Center Management System
projects.tagline: Complete healthcare diagnostic clinic portal for lab tests, appointments, doctor schedules & medical billing
projects.description: A comprehensive digital hospital & diagnostic clinic solution automating patient registration, appointment scheduling, laboratory pathology test tracking, digital invoice billing, and medical report delivery.
features: Patient registry with unique patient ID (PID) and complete medical visit history
Diagnostic lab test catalog (Blood tests, X-Ray, ECG, Ultrasonography, MRI)
Doctor appointment scheduling with date & time slot booking calendar
Automated bill calculation with discount vouchers, paid amounts, and due tracking
Pathology report entry system with printable/downloadable lab test results
Multi-role user authentication (Receptionist, Lab Technologist, Doctor, Admin)
Financial revenue analytics and daily transaction ledger reports
projects.overview: Healthcare facilities need robust, error-free management to handle thousands of patient samples and clinical records daily. This diagnostic center portal digitizes the entire lifecycle from patient entry to test sample collection and final report generation.
projects.problem: Paper-based patient records and handwritten lab reports result in lost diagnostic data, long queues at payment counters, and delays in delivering critical medical test findings.
projects.solution: Engineered a database-driven healthcare platform with clean clinical workflows. Patients receive automated invoices with test barcodes, pathologists log verified lab metrics, and admins monitor real-time daily hospital revenue.
developmentProcess: Consulted diagnostic lab workflows to blueprint pathology test attributes and normal range values
Architected relational schema in MySQL with foreign key constraints for patient test orders and billings
Developed responsive admin and receptionist portals with rapid patient search and instant test selection
Implemented PDF report generator module formatting test results with clinic header and doctor signature
Security audit for role isolation ensuring lab staff only modify medical results while reception manages billing
challenges: Structuring dynamic pathology test parameters where each test has distinct normal range metrics and units
Ensuring accurate ledger computations when partial payments, refunds, and corporate discounts are applied
futureImprovements: Online patient portal for downloading test reports via SMS token link
Barcode & QR code scanner integration on lab specimen tubes
